Welcome to the lab

Experiments in flavour, served fresh

Kevon's Food Lab is a restaurant and café at Cargills Square, Bandarawela — cooking kottu, pasta, pizza, cakes and seasonal feasts with zero artificial flavours.

Give us a try! We believe in your satisfaction — tell us your preferences and we’ll make it your way. Dine in at the lab, or order on WhatsApp for delivery to your doorstep in Bandarawela.
